research_question: Can a frozen 2x training weight on the valid SawFM sweep-period regression term remove its replicated negative transfer while preserving the heterogeneous route's other 11 parameter gains and classification behavior?

mechanism.single_training_change: SawFM sweep-period valid SmoothL1 term weight is 2.0 instead of 1.0
mechanism.weighted_loss_normalization: sum(weighted valid element losses) divided by sum(valid element weights)
mechanism.fixed_weight_selection: chosen before reading any P4g sample or result; no weight sweep is permitted

prior_evidence_boundary.p4c_p4d: frozen positive aggregate evidence and SawFM failure attribution only

training.paired_batch_order: same model seed and independently seeded DataLoader generator

stop_rule: Do not tune the multiplier on seed710000000. If any primary SawFM-period gate fails, stop supervised target-reweighting for this target and retain P4c/P4d as the aggregate heterogeneous-route result with an explicit SawFM limitation.
next_if_pass: Freeze the 2x loss method and run two new generator seeds without training, calibration, or threshold changes; then perform five-seed and strict equal-compute confirmation.
